name: Shanghai International Airport Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai International Airport Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of aviation services within China. Its extensive offerings encompass essential regulatory and passenger processing functions, including customs clearance, security screening, inspection and quarantine protocols, border control for arrivals and departures, and support for flight delay management and visa procedures, as well as smoking area regulation. Beyond these passenger-focused services, the company also delivers a comprehensive array of operational and commercial support. This includes air cargo handling, premium VIP services, advertising opportunities, aircraft fueling, and ground agency operations, alongside dedicated business aviation services. Diversifying its portfolio further, Shanghai International Airport Co., Ltd. additionally manages hotel operations. The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China, and functions as a subsidiary of Shanghai Airport (Group) Co., Ltd.
